en.headline: Two arrested after 160km/h run on Kwun Tong Bypass
en.dek: East Kowloon traffic police said one driver more than doubled the 80km/h limit and weaved between lanes during Operation Fei Shield on 17 and 18 September.
body: Police arrested two local men, aged 25 and 35, for suspected dangerous driving after a targeted operation on and around the Kwun Tong Bypass, East Kowloon traffic officers said.

In one case, a driver reached 160 kilometres an hour or more on a stretch limited to 80 kilometres an hour and weaved between lanes, posing a serious risk to other road users, police said. The enforcement, code-named Fei Shield, or FASTSHIELD, ran over key periods on 17 and 18 September and continued a campaign begun last month against serious traffic offences.

Officers also detected two private cars for serious speeding and will prosecute those drivers by summons. Another private car suspected of illegal modification, and two motorcycles, were taken to the Kowloon Bay vehicle detention centre for inspection. Officers used drones with unmarked cars to spot suspected offences from the air before stopping target vehicles.

The arrested men were granted bail and must report back in late October. Police said dangerous driving under the Road Traffic Ordinance carries a maximum fine of HK$25,000 and three years' imprisonment, with a driving disqualification of at least six months.

zh.headline: 觀塘繞道反危駕拘兩男 有車時速160公里
zh.dek: 東九龍交通部指，17至18日「飛盾」行動中，一名司機在限速80公里路段車速達160公里或以上，並在行車線之間穿插。
body: 東九龍總區交通部表示，人員在觀塘繞道一帶持續展開代號「飛盾」的執法行動，打擊危險駕駛，於9月17日至18日重點時段拘捕兩名本地男子，分別25歲及35歲，涉嫌危險駕駛。
警方指，其中一宗個案中，涉案司機在時速限制80公里的路段，車速一度達每小時160公里或以上，並在行車線之間左穿右插，對其他道路使用者構成嚴重危險。行動延續上月策略，以打擊嚴重交通違法及減少嚴重意外為目標。
人員另偵測到兩輛私家車嚴重超速，將以傳票檢控；另一輛私家車涉嫌非法改裝，不適宜在道路上行駛。該改裝私家車及兩輛電單車已被扣留至九龍灣車輛扣留中心檢驗。警方指行動以無人機配合隱形戰車，先從高空觀察路面再截查目標車輛。
所有被捕人已獲准保釋候查，須於10月下旬向警方報到。警方重申，根據《道路交通條例》，危險駕駛最高可處罰款2.5萬元及監禁三年，並可被停牌至少六個月。
